name: L-Sit Pull-Up
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and an overhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your trunk and lift your legs together until they extend horizontally in front of you.
Pull your chest smoothly upward until your chin clears the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself slowly back to a straight-arm hang while keeping your legs elevated at 90 degrees.
tips: Avoid swinging your legs downward to help start the pull.
Keep your abs and hip flexors braced continuously so your legs stay horizontal from start to finish.
